objects.definition: typedef struct spvc_context_s *spvc_context;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a SPIRV-Cross C API context. The context owns all allocations for child objects and returned strings/arrays. It must be created with spvc_context_create and destroyed with spvc_context_destroy. All returned pointers remain valid while the context is alive and until spvc_context_release_allocations is called.

objects.definition: typedef struct spvc_parsed_ir_s *spvc_parsed_ir;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a parsed SPIR-V intermediate representation extracted by the C API. Created by spvc_context_parse_spirv. Can be consumed by a compiler instance using capture modes.

objects.definition: typedef struct spvc_compiler_s *spvc_compiler;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a compiler backend instance (GLSL/HLSL/MSL/CPP/JSON or reflection). Created from a context and a parsed IR with a specified capture mode. Used to configure options, reflect resources, and compile to target source.

objects.definition: typedef struct spvc_compiler_options_s *spvc_compiler_options;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a set of compiler options specific to a compiler backend. Create via spvc_compiler_create_compiler_options, set options, then install into a compiler with spvc_compiler_install_compiler_options.

objects.definition: typedef struct spvc_resources_s *spvc_resources;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a snapshot of reflected shader resources. Created by spvc_compiler_create_shader_resources or the active-variables variant. Holds lists of spvc_reflected_resource entries grouped by resource type.

objects.definition:
struct spvc_type_s;
typedef const struct spvc_type_s *spvc_type;
objects.description: Opaque read-only handle to a SPIR-V type (SPIRType). Retrieved from a compiler with a type ID and queried through spvc_type_* accessors. Only a forward declaration is provided here.

objects.definition: typedef struct spvc_constant_s *spvc_constant;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a SPIR-V constant (SPIRConstant). Obtained from a compiler by ID and queried or modified with spvc_constant_* functions.

objects.definition:
struct spvc_set_s;
typedef const struct spvc_set_s *spvc_set;
objects.description: Opaque read-only handle representing a set of active interface variable IDs. Created and consumed through spvc_compiler_get_active_interface_variables and spvc_compiler_set_enabled_interface_variables.

objects.definition: typedef SpvId spvc_type_id;
objects.description: Typedef alias for a SPIR-V Id that refers to a SPIRType. Pointer form shown; values are passed by value in API calls.

objects.definition: typedef SpvId spvc_variable_id;
objects.description: Typedef alias for a SPIR-V Id that refers to a SPIRVariable. Pointer form shown; values are passed by value in API calls.

objects.definition: typedef SpvId spvc_constant_id;
objects.description: Typedef alias for a SPIR-V Id that refers to a SPIRConstant. Pointer form shown; values are passed by value in API calls.

objects.definition: typedef unsigned char spvc_bool;

objects.description: Enumeration of all compiler option keys, namespaced by backend bit masks. Used with spvc_compiler_options_set_* APIs.

C++ backend code generator for SPIRV-Cross that emits C/C++-style output. Inherits from CompilerGLSL to reuse common GLSL-oriented logic but overrides methods to generate C/C++ code. Provides multiple constructors accepting SPIR-V binaries or parsed IR, a compile() entry point, and internal helpers for emitting resources, buffers, uniforms, and function prototypes. Manages internal state such as resource registration strings, implementation/resource type strings, a shared variable counter, and an optional interface symbol name.

Forward declaration of a simple_json::Stream class. Only an incomplete type is provided here; definition is elsewhere. Likely represents a JSON streaming/writing utility used by the reflection compiler to output JSON.

Reflection compiler deriving from CompilerGLSL that emits reflection information (likely JSON) for a SPIR-V module. Sets Vulkan semantics in options and provides multiple constructors from SPIR-V binaries or IR. Offers compile() and helpers to emit entry points, types, resources, specialization constants, and various type/member utilities. Holds a JSON Stream for output.
Describes a reflected SPIR-V resource variable (e.g., UBO, SSBO, image). Holds the variable ID, its full type ID, the underlying base type ID, and an optional declared name.
Reflection record for a built-in interface variable or struct member (e.g., Position). Stores the BuiltIn enum, the value type ID, and the containing Resource.
Aggregates all reflected resources of a shader, grouped by category. Used as the return value of get_shader_resources().
Represents a remapped combined image-sampler pair synthesized by the compiler when targets do not support separate image/sampler. Holds IDs for the combined, image, and sampler.
Describes a specialization constant: its SPIR-V ID and its Vulkan constant ID number.
Represents a used byte range of a buffer member: member index, byte offset, and byte range as found by analysis.

Identifies an entry point by name and ExecutionModel; used for querying and selecting entry points.

Main compiler and reflection interface for SPIRV-Cross. Consumes parsed SPIR-V (ParsedIR) and provides reflection, analysis utilities, and code generation via compile(). Contains multiple internal handler structs for traversals.
Sparse-growable bitset optimized for first 64 bits; spills higher bits into an unordered_set. Used for decoration flags and metadata.
Abstract interface for formatting float and double literals with backend-specific rules.
Represents a SPIR-V instruction entry in a stream, with opcode, word count, and location metadata.
Instruction that stores its operands inline (embedded) rather than by offset into a stream.
Type-erased ID wrapper convertible to and from specific TypedID specializations. Alias ID is a using of this type.
Primary template for a strongly-typed ID. Specific aliases map to SPIR-V object categories. This entry documents the template definition; aliases define concrete kinds.
Abstract base for all pooled variant node types stored in the IR. Carries its own ID and supports pool-based cloning.
Represents an OpUndef value with a specific base type.
Holds an owned string in the IR variant system (e.g., names).
Represents a combined image-sampler object, storing separate IDs for image and sampler and the combined type.
Deferred constant expression (OpSpecConstantOp or similar), storing opcode and arguments.
Describes a SPIR-V type, including scalars, vectors, matrices, arrays, pointers, structs, images/samplers, and backend-specific extensions.
Represents use of an extended instruction set or non-semantic extension referenced in the module.
Holds per-entry-point metadata such as interface variables, workgroup size, and execution model.
Represents an intermediate expression in generated source, tracking dependencies and transformation flags.
Holds a function type signature: return type and parameter type IDs.
Represents a basic block with control-flow terminators, merge info, phi variables, cases for switches, and bookkeeping for SSA and loops.
Represents a function definition with parameters, locals, basic blocks, and various backend fix-up hooks.
IR node that encodes a pointer-like access chain into buffers with layout info for backends needing raw addressing.
Declares a SPIR-V variable with storage class, initializer, and various analysis flags used during lowering and codegen.
Represents a constant or specialization constant, including composite construction and helpers for scalar extraction and conversions.
Holds per-variant-type object pools used to allocate and clone IVariant-derived nodes.
Type-erased owning handle to an IVariant node allocated from object pools; supports safe casting and controlled type replacement.
Metadata collected when resolving an access chain; used to drive codegen details such as packing, transpose, and builtin usage.
Holds reflection metadata (names, locations, builtins, extended decorations) for IDs and struct members.
Simple FNV-1a-like hasher for building small hashes of tuples of u32 values.
Pair key for descriptor set and binding numbers, with comparison ops for maps/sets.
Key combining location and component, for input/output interface mapping.
Key combining shader stage with set/binding, for per-stage resource binding maps.
Custom hash functors for unordered containers keyed by small POD pairs/tuples used in resource mapping.

Central IR container for SPIRV-Cross. Holds raw SPIR-V words, typed IDs, metadata, type/variable lists, entry points, and decoration utilities. Provides iteration helpers and loop-iteration locks to prevent mutation while traversing typed ID arrays. Copy is deep due to object pools; move supported. Destruction order requires pool_group to outlive pooled objects in ids.

RAII guard used by ParsedIR to manage loop-iteration depth locks when iterating typed ID arrays. Constructing increments/decrements a counter via the provided pointer, enforcing hard/soft mutation rules during iteration.
Small POD recording original source language information of the module: language, version, whether ES profile, known-ness, and HLSL flag.

objects.definition: using BlockMetaFlags = uint8_t;
objects.description: Alias for the bitset type used to store block metadata flags on basic blocks within ParsedIR.
Enumeration of bit positions describing control-flow metadata for blocks: loop headers, continue blocks, loop merges, selection merges, and multi-selection merges.

Control Flow Graph utility for a SPIR-V function. Builds and queries dominator relationships, reachability, and edge adjacency within a function. Holds references to a Compiler and the SPIRFunction it analyzes. Provides traversal and dominator computations. Construction requires a Compiler and SPIRFunction; lifetime must outlive references. Destruction has no special behavior indicated.

Helper class to incrementally compute a common dominator of a set of blocks using a CFG. Call add_block for each block; query with get_dominator. lift_continue_block_dominator tweaks the result for continue blocks. Holds a reference to a CFG; it must remain valid.

Concrete parser class for SPIR-V modules within SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE. It owns a ParsedIR instance and provides parsing entry points from raw words or a vector. It tracks current function and block during parsing and offers helpers to register and query typed IDs in the IR. Details of SPIRFunction, SPIRBlock, SPIRType, SPIRVariable, Instruction, SmallVector, Types, and IR internals are declared elsewhere.
Abstract base for object pools, enabling type-erased deallocation of pooled objects.

Exception type used by SPIRV-Cross to signal compiler/translation errors when exceptions are enabled. It derives from std::runtime_error and provides string and C-string constructors. When exceptions are disabled (SPIRV_CROSS_EXCEPTIONS_TO_ASSERTIONS defined), this class is not compiled and errors abort instead.

objects.description: Enumeration of all SPIR-V opcodes. This header provides a comprehensive list; due to length, see definition for full set. Ensure correct usage per SPIR-V spec.

functions.name: spvc_get_version
functions.description: Writes the library’s compile-time major/minor/patch version numbers to the provided pointers. Useful for detecting ABI/API compatibility.
requirements: major must be a valid writable pointer or NULL if not needed.
minor must be a valid writable pointer or NULL if not needed.
patch must be a valid writable pointer or NULL if not needed.
The function performs no allocation and never fails.

functions.name: spvc_get_commit_revision_and_timestamp
functions.description: Returns a human-readable version string identifying the commit revision and timestamp the binary was built from. The returned string is owned by the library.
requirements: The returned pointer is valid for the lifetime of the library process and must not be freed by the caller.

functions.name: spvc_msl_vertex_attribute_init
functions.description: Initializes an spvc_msl_vertex_attribute struct to default values. Deprecated in favor of newer interfaces but provided for ABI compatibility.
requirements: attr must be a valid writable pointer.
Caller should treat unspecified defaults as implementation-defined.

functions.name: spvc_msl_shader_interface_var_init
functions.description: Initializes an spvc_msl_shader_interface_var to defaults. Deprecated, prefer spvc_msl_shader_interface_var_init_2().
requirements: var must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: spvc_msl_shader_input_init
functions.description: Initializes an spvc_msl_shader_input (alias of spvc_msl_shader_interface_var) to defaults. Deprecated, prefer spvc_msl_shader_interface_var_init_2().
requirements: input must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: spvc_msl_shader_interface_var_init_2
functions.description: Initializes an spvc_msl_shader_interface_var_2 to default values for MSL shader interface variables.
requirements: var must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: spvc_msl_resource_binding_init
functions.description: Initializes an spvc_msl_resource_binding with default (non-zero) values. Deprecated; prefer spvc_msl_resource_binding_init_2().
requirements: binding must be a valid writable pointer.
Defaults are non-zero as documented.

functions.name: spvc_msl_resource_binding_init_2
functions.description: Initializes an spvc_msl_resource_binding_2 with default (non-zero) values for MSL resource binding remaps.
requirements: binding must be a valid writable pointer.
Defaults are non-zero as documented.

functions.name: spvc_msl_get_aux_buffer_struct_version
functions.description: Returns a runtime version number for an obsolete/auxiliary buffer struct interface, kept for compatibility.
requirements: No special requirements; pure query.

functions.name: spvc_msl_constexpr_sampler_init
functions.description: Initializes an spvc_msl_constexpr_sampler struct to default (non-zero) configuration for MSL constexpr samplers.
requirements: sampler must be a valid writable pointer.
Defaults include non-zero values; caller should override as needed.

functions.name: spvc_msl_sampler_ycbcr_conversion_init
functions.description: Initializes an spvc_msl_sampler_ycbcr_conversion struct to defaults corresponding to the Y'CbCr-related fields of MSLConstexprSampler.
requirements: conv must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: spvc_hlsl_resource_binding_init
functions.description: Initializes an spvc_hlsl_resource_binding struct with default (non-zero) values for HLSL register/space remaps.
requirements: binding must be a valid writable pointer.
Defaults are non-zero as documented.

functions.name: spvc_context_create
functions.description: Creates a new SPIRV-Cross C API context that owns all allocations for derived objects and strings.
requirements: context must be a valid writable pointer.
On success, *context receives a valid handle; on failure, returns SPVC_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY.
Caller must later call spvc_context_destroy(context) to free all resources.

functions.name: spvc_context_destroy
functions.description: Destroys a context and frees all memory and objects owned by it and its descendants.
requirements: context may be NULL; if non-NULL it must be a valid context handle created by spvc_context_create.
After this call, all pointers allocated from the context become invalid.

functions.name: spvc_context_release_allocations
functions.description: Frees all allocations and objects owned by the context but keeps the context itself alive for reuse.
requirements: context must be a valid context handle.
After this call, previously returned non-opaque pointers/strings from the context become invalid.

functions.name: spvc_context_get_last_error_string
functions.description: Returns the last logged error string for the given context, or NULL if none. String is owned by the context.
requirements: context must be a valid context handle.
Returned pointer is invalidated by spvc_context_release_allocations or spvc_context_destroy and must not be freed by the caller.

functions.name: spvc_context_set_error_callback
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API void spvc_context_set_error_callback(spvc_context context, spvc_error_callback cb, void *userdata);
functions.description: Registers a callback to be notified when an error is logged on the context. Useful for debugging.
requirements: context must be a valid context.
cb may be NULL to clear the callback; if non-NULL, it must be callable for the duration it is registered.
userdata is passed back unchanged to the callback.

functions.name: spvc_context_parse_spirv
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_context_parse_spirv(spvc_context context, const SpvId *spirv, size_t word_count, spvc_parsed_ir *parsed_ir);
functions.description: Parses a SPIR-V module (as 32-bit words) into an internal Parsed IR handle associated with the context.
requirements: context must be a valid context.
spirv must point to an array of word_count 32-bit words containing a SPIR-V module.
word_count must be the number of 32-bit words in spirv.
parsed_ir must be a valid writable pointer.
On success, *parsed_ir receives a handle; errors include SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT, SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_SPIRV, or SPVC_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

functions.name: spvc_context_create_compiler
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_context_create_compiler(spvc_context context, spvc_backend backend, spvc_parsed_ir parsed_ir, spvc_capture_mode mode, spvc_compiler *compiler);
functions.description: Creates a compiler for the specified backend from a parsed IR using copy or move (ownership) capture modes.
requirements: context must be valid.
backend must be one of spvc_backend values; SPVC_BACKEND_NONE enables reflection-only behavior.
parsed_ir must be a valid parsed IR handle produced by this context.
mode controls ownership; with SPVC_CAPTURE_MODE_TAKE_OWNERSHIP, parsed_ir becomes invalid after the call.
compiler must be a valid writable pointer.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or an error result (e.g., SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT, SPVC_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY).

functions.name: spvc_compiler_get_current_id_bound
functions.description: Returns the current SPIR-V ID bound used by the compiler’s IR (max ID + 1).
requirements: compiler must be a valid compiler handle.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_create_compiler_options
functions.description: Allocates and initializes an options object with backend-specific default settings for the given compiler.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
options must be a valid writable pointer.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_options_set_bool
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_options_set_bool(spvc_compiler_options options, spvc_compiler_option option, spvc_bool value);
functions.description: Sets a boolean compiler option on an options object. Fails if the option is invalid for the compiler’s backend.
requirements: options must be a valid options handle created for a specific compiler/backend.
option must be a valid spvc_compiler_option enumerant compatible with the backend.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_options_set_uint
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_options_set_uint(spvc_compiler_options options, spvc_compiler_option option, unsigned value);
functions.description: Sets an unsigned-integer compiler option on an options object. Fails if the option is invalid for the backend.
requirements: options must be valid.
option must be a valid spvc_compiler_option enumerant compatible with the backend.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_install_compiler_options
functions.description: Installs/overrides the compiler’s options with the provided options object.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
options must be an options handle created for this compiler/backend.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_compile
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_compile(spvc_compiler compiler, const char **source);
functions.description: Compiles the current IR to the target backend, returning a pointer to a null-terminated source string owned by the context.
requirements: compiler must be valid and configured for a backend that supports compilation (not SPVC_BACKEND_NONE).
source must be a valid writable pointer; on success, *source is set to context-owned memory which must not be freed by the caller.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or an error such as SPVC_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_SPIRV, SPVC_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_add_header_line
functions.description: Injects a single line into the generated source header section prior to compilation (backend-dependent behavior).
requirements: compiler must be valid.
line must be a non-NULL C string.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_require_extension
functions.description: Declares that the generated source requires the named extension (backend-specific effect).
requirements: compiler must be valid.
ext must be a non-NULL C string naming an extension.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_get_num_required_extensions
functions.description: Returns the number of extensions the compiler currently marks as required.
requirements: compiler must be valid.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_get_required_extension
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API const char *spvc_compiler_get_required_extension(spvc_compiler compiler, size_t index);
functions.description: Returns the name of a required extension by index. String lifetime is tied to the context.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
index must be less than spvc_compiler_get_num_required_extensions(compiler).
Returned pointer must not be freed and is invalidated when the context releases allocations.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_flatten_buffer_block
functions.description: Flattens a buffer block (e.g., uniform/storage struct) into a flat set of members for certain backends.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
id must be a valid SPIR-V variable ID for a buffer block.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_variable_is_depth_or_compare
functions.description: Returns whether a variable represents a depth texture or compare sampler/image as recognized by the backend.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
id must be a valid SPIR-V variable ID.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_mask_stage_output_by_location
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_mask_stage_output_by_location(spvc_compiler compiler, unsigned location, unsigned component);
functions.description: Marks a specific stage output (location/component) as used, masking out others for code generation.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
location must be a valid stage output location in the module.
component is the component index to preserve.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_mask_stage_output_by_builtin
functions.description: Marks a specific built-in stage output as used, masking out others for code generation.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
builtin must be a valid SpvBuiltIn enumerant present as output in the module.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_hlsl_set_root_constants_layout
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_hlsl_set_root_constants_layout(spvc_compiler compiler, const spvc_hlsl_root_constants *constant_info, size_t count);
functions.description: Configures HLSL root constants layout entries for the compiler.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target HLSL backend.
constant_info must point to an array of count entries or be NULL if count is 0.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_hlsl_add_vertex_attribute_remap
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_hlsl_add_vertex_attribute_remap(spvc_compiler compiler, const spvc_hlsl_vertex_attribute_remap *remap, size_t remaps);
functions.description: Adds one or more HLSL vertex attribute location-to-semantic remaps.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target HLSL backend.
remap must point to an array of length remaps or be NULL if remaps is 0.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_hlsl_remap_num_workgroups_builtin
functions.description: Creates/remaps the HLSL builtin for NumWorkGroups and returns the associated variable id.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target HLSL backend.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_hlsl_set_resource_binding_flags
functions.description: Sets automatic resource binding behavior flags for HLSL compilation.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target HLSL backend.
flags is a bitmask of spvc_hlsl_binding_flag_bits.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_hlsl_add_resource_binding
functions.description: Adds a specific HLSL resource binding mapping (set/binding to register/space) for a stage.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target HLSL backend.
binding must be a valid pointer to an initialized spvc_hlsl_resource_binding.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_hlsl_is_resource_used
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_bool spvc_compiler_hlsl_is_resource_used(spvc_compiler compiler, SpvExecutionModel model, unsigned set, unsigned binding);
functions.description: Queries if a resource at (set,binding) is used by the shader for a given execution model in HLSL context.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
model must be a valid SpvExecutionModel.
set and binding are resource binding coordinates.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_is_rasterization_disabled
functions.description: Returns whether rasterization is disabled for the current MSL pipeline stage configuration.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_needs_aux_buffer
functions.description: Deprecated alias for needs_swizzle_buffer; returns whether an auxiliary/swizzle buffer is required by generated MSL.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_needs_swizzle_buffer
functions.description: Returns whether the generated MSL will require a swizzle buffer.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_needs_buffer_size_buffer
functions.description: Returns whether the generated MSL will require a buffer-size buffer.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_needs_output_buffer
functions.description: Returns whether the generated MSL will require an output buffer.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_needs_patch_output_buffer
functions.description: Returns whether the generated MSL will require a patch output buffer (e.g., for tessellation).
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_needs_input_threadgroup_mem
functions.description: Returns whether the generated MSL will require input threadgroup memory.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_add_vertex_attribute
functions.description: Adds an MSL vertex attribute mapping. Deprecated struct fields remain for ABI only.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
attrs must point to an initialized spvc_msl_vertex_attribute.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_add_resource_binding
functions.description: Adds an MSL resource binding remap. Deprecated; prefer spvc_compiler_msl_add_resource_binding_2().
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
binding must point to an initialized spvc_msl_resource_binding.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_add_resource_binding_2
functions.description: Adds an MSL resource binding remap with array count support.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
binding must point to an initialized spvc_msl_resource_binding_2.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_add_shader_input
functions.description: Adds an MSL shader input override. Deprecated; use spvc_compiler_msl_add_shader_input_2().
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
input must point to an initialized spvc_msl_shader_interface_var.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_add_shader_input_2
functions.description: Adds an MSL shader input override with variable rate support.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
input must point to an initialized spvc_msl_shader_interface_var_2.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_add_shader_output
functions.description: Adds an MSL shader output override. Deprecated; use spvc_compiler_msl_add_shader_output_2().
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
output must point to an initialized spvc_msl_shader_interface_var.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_add_shader_output_2
functions.description: Adds an MSL shader output override with variable rate support.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
output must point to an initialized spvc_msl_shader_interface_var_2.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_add_discrete_descriptor_set
functions.description: Marks a descriptor set as discrete when targeting MSL (argument buffers).
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
desc_set is the descriptor set index to mark discrete.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_set_argument_buffer_device_address_space
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_msl_set_argument_buffer_device_address_space(spvc_compiler compiler, unsigned desc_set, spvc_bool device_address);
functions.description: Controls whether a given MSL argument buffer (by descriptor set) uses device address space.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_is_vertex_attribute_used
functions.description: Deprecated; use is_shader_input_used. Returns whether a vertex attribute location is used.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
location is a vertex input location.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_is_shader_input_used
functions.description: Returns whether a shader input location is used by the shader.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
location is a shader input location.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_is_shader_output_used
functions.description: Returns whether a shader output location is used by the shader.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
location is a shader output location.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_is_resource_used
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_bool spvc_compiler_msl_is_resource_used(spvc_compiler compiler, SpvExecutionModel model, unsigned set, unsigned binding);
functions.description: Queries if a resource at (set,binding) is used for the given execution model in MSL context.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
model must be a valid SpvExecutionModel.
set and binding specify the resource.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_remap_constexpr_sampler
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_msl_remap_constexpr_sampler(spvc_compiler compiler, spvc_variable_id id, const spvc_msl_constexpr_sampler *sampler);
functions.description: Associates a SPIR-V sampler variable with an MSL constexpr sampler configuration.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
id must be the SPIR-V variable ID of the sampler to remap.
sampler must point to an initialized spvc_msl_constexpr_sampler.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_remap_constexpr_sampler_by_binding
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_msl_remap_constexpr_sampler_by_binding(spvc_compiler compiler, unsigned desc_set, unsigned binding, const spvc_msl_constexpr_sampler *sampler);
functions.description: Associates a descriptor (set,binding) sampler with an MSL constexpr sampler.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
sampler must point to an initialized spvc_msl_constexpr_sampler.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_remap_constexpr_sampler_ycbcr
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_msl_remap_constexpr_sampler_ycbcr(spvc_compiler compiler, spvc_variable_id id, const spvc_msl_constexpr_sampler *sampler, const spvc_msl_sampler_ycbcr_conversion *conv);
functions.description: Associates a sampler variable with an MSL constexpr sampler and Y'CbCr conversion configuration.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
id must be a sampler variable ID.
sampler and conv must point to initialized structs.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_remap_constexpr_sampler_by_binding_ycbcr
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_msl_remap_constexpr_sampler_by_binding_ycbcr(spvc_compiler compiler, unsigned desc_set, unsigned binding, const spvc_msl_constexpr_sampler *sampler, const spvc_msl_sampler_ycbcr_conversion *conv);
functions.description: Associates a descriptor (set,binding) sampler with an MSL constexpr sampler and Y'CbCr conversion configuration.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
sampler and conv must point to initialized structs.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_set_fragment_output_components
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_msl_set_fragment_output_components(spvc_compiler compiler, unsigned location, unsigned components);
functions.description: Overrides the number of components for a fragment output location in MSL.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
location must be a valid fragment output location.
components specifies the component count.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_get_automatic_resource_binding
functions.description: Returns the automatically assigned resource binding index for a SPIR-V variable in MSL.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
id must be a valid resource variable ID.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_get_automatic_resource_binding_secondary
functions.description: Returns the secondary automatic resource binding index for a SPIR-V variable in MSL (e.g., sampler/image pairs).
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
id must be a valid resource variable ID.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_add_dynamic_buffer
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_msl_add_dynamic_buffer(spvc_compiler compiler, unsigned desc_set, unsigned binding, unsigned index);
functions.description: Declares a descriptor (set,binding) as a dynamic buffer at a specific dynamic index for MSL.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_add_inline_uniform_block
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_msl_add_inline_uniform_block(spvc_compiler compiler, unsigned desc_set, unsigned binding);
functions.description: Marks a descriptor (set,binding) as an inline uniform block for MSL mapping.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_set_combined_sampler_suffix
functions.description: Sets a name suffix to use when generating combined sampler names in MSL.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
suffix must be a non-NULL C string.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_msl_get_combined_sampler_suffix
functions.description: Gets the current combined sampler name suffix for MSL. String is owned by the context.
requirements: compiler must be valid and target MSL backend.
Returned pointer must not be freed and is invalidated when the context releases allocations.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_get_active_interface_variables
functions.description: Retrieves the set of active interface variable IDs used by the entry point.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
set must be a valid writable pointer; on success receives an opaque set handle owned by the context.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or an error.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_set_enabled_interface_variables
functions.description: Overrides which interface variables are considered enabled by providing a set of variable IDs.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
set must be a valid set handle created by this context or NULL to clear.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_create_shader_resources
functions.description: Creates a reflection object enumerating resources in the shader.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
resources must be a valid writable pointer; on success receives a handle owned by the context.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_create_shader_resources_for_active_variables
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_create_shader_resources_for_active_variables(spvc_compiler compiler, spvc_resources *resources, spvc_set active);
functions.description: Creates a reflection object limited to a provided set of active interface variables.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
resources must be writable pointer.
active must be a valid set handle specifying active variables.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_resources_get_resource_list_for_type
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_resources_get_resource_list_for_type(spvc_resources resources, spvc_resource_type type, const spvc_reflected_resource **resource_list, size_t *resource_size);
functions.description: Obtains a pointer to an array of reflected resources for the given resource type and its element count.

type must be a valid spvc_resource_type.
resource_list and resource_size must be valid writable pointers.

functions.name: spvc_resources_get_builtin_resource_list_for_type
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_resources_get_builtin_resource_list_for_type(spvc_resources resources, spvc_builtin_resource_type type, const spvc_reflected_builtin_resource **resource_list, size_t *resource_size);

requirements: resources must be valid.
type must be a valid spvc_builtin_resource_type.
resource_list and resource_size must be valid writable pointers.
Returned array is owned by the context.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or SPVC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_set_decoration
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API void spvc_compiler_set_decoration(spvc_compiler compiler, SpvId id, SpvDecoration decoration, unsigned argument);

id must be a valid SPIR-V ID.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_set_decoration_string
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API void spvc_compiler_set_decoration_string(spvc_compiler compiler, SpvId id, SpvDecoration decoration, const char *argument);
functions.description: Sets a string decoration on an ID.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
id must be a valid SPIR-V ID.
decoration must accept string arguments.
argument must be a non-NULL C string.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_set_name
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API void spvc_compiler_set_name(spvc_compiler compiler, SpvId id, const char *argument);
functions.description: Sets the friendly name for an ID in generated source/reflection.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
id must be a valid SPIR-V ID.
argument must be a non-NULL C string.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_set_member_decoration
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API void spvc_compiler_set_member_decoration(spvc_compiler compiler, spvc_type_id id, unsigned member_index, SpvDecoration decoration, unsigned argument);
functions.description: Sets a numeric decoration on a struct member.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
id must be a SPIRType ID (base type).
member_index must be within member count of the struct.
decoration must accept an unsigned argument.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_set_member_decoration_string
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API void spvc_compiler_set_member_decoration_string(spvc_compiler compiler, spvc_type_id id, unsigned member_index, SpvDecoration decoration, const char *argument);
functions.description: Sets a string decoration on a struct member.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
id must be a SPIRType ID (base type).
member_index must be valid for the struct.
argument must be a non-NULL C string.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_set_member_name
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API void spvc_compiler_set_member_name(spvc_compiler compiler, spvc_type_id id, unsigned member_index, const char *argument);
functions.description: Sets the friendly name of a struct member.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
id must be a SPIRType ID (base type).
member_index must be valid.
argument must be a non-NULL C string.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_unset_decoration
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API void spvc_compiler_unset_decoration(spvc_compiler compiler, SpvId id, SpvDecoration decoration);
functions.description: Removes a decoration from an ID.

functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_get_declared_capabilities(spvc_compiler compiler, const SpvCapability **capabilities, size_t *num_capabilities);
functions.description: Returns the list of declared SPIR-V capabilities in the module and its count.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
capabilities and num_capabilities must be writable pointers.
Returned array is context-owned.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or error.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_get_declared_extensions
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_get_declared_extensions(spvc_compiler compiler, const char ***extensions, size_t *num_extensions);
functions.description: Returns the list of declared SPIR-V extension strings and its count.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
extensions and num_extensions must be writable pointers.
Returned array and strings are context-owned.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or error.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_get_remapped_declared_block_name
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API const char *spvc_compiler_get_remapped_declared_block_name(spvc_compiler compiler, spvc_variable_id id);
functions.description: Returns the remapped declared block name for a buffer block variable, if any. String is owned by the context.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
id must be a buffer block variable ID.
Returned pointer is context-owned.

functions.name: spvc_compiler_get_buffer_block_decorations
functions.signature: SPVC_PUBLIC_API spvc_result spvc_compiler_get_buffer_block_decorations(spvc_compiler compiler, spvc_variable_id id, const SpvDecoration **decorations, size_t *num_decorations);
functions.description: Returns the set of decorations that apply to a buffer block variable and their count.
requirements: compiler must be valid.
id must be a buffer block variable ID.
decorations and num_decorations must be writable pointers.
Returned array is context-owned.
Returns SPVC_SUCCESS or error.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::remap_pixel_local_storage
functions.description: Configures mappings for pixel local storage (PLS) inputs and outputs, then triggers internal remapping of PLS variables. Intended for GLSL ES targets supporting GL_EXT_shader_pixel_local_storage. Call before compile() to affect generated GLSL.
requirements: Must be called before compile() for changes to take effect.
inputs and outputs vectors contain PlsRemap entries where id identifies a variable and format specifies its PlsFormat.
Behavior and effect are backend/target dependent; only meaningful when emitting GLSL ES with pixel local storage support.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::remap_ext_framebuffer_fetch
functions.signature: void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::remap_ext_framebuffer_fetch(uint32_t input_attachment_index, uint32_t color_location, bool coherent)
functions.description: Redirects a subpassInput read (identified by input_attachment_index) to fetch from a color attachment at the given location using the EXT_shader_framebuffer_fetch mechanism on ESSL targets. If coherent is true, uses the coherent extension variant; otherwise uses the noncoherent variant.
requirements: Requires ESSL (OpenGL ES GLSL output).
Call before compile() so the remapping is reflected in the emitted GLSL.
input_attachment_index must refer to an existing subpassInput in the module.
color_location must correspond to a color attachment location used by the fragment shader.
If coherent is true, the target environment must support the coherent framebuffer fetch extension; otherwise noncoherent extension must be available.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::CompilerGLSL
functions.description: Constructs a GLSL compiler from a SPIR-V binary provided as a vector of 32-bit words. Takes ownership of the vector contents (moved) and initializes internal state.
requirements: spirv_ must contain a valid SPIR-V module (sequence of 32-bit words).
The vector is moved into the compiler; the caller should not rely on its previous contents after construction.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::get_common_options
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the current GLSL backend options controlling code generation (version, ES mode, precision defaults, etc.). Use to inspect the active settings.
requirements: The returned reference is valid as long as the CompilerGLSL instance remains alive and unmodified by set_common_options.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::set_common_options
functions.description: Sets the GLSL backend options to control subsequent code generation (GLSL version/ES, precision, layout handling, etc.).
requirements: Call before compile() to affect the emitted GLSL for that compilation.
opts should be configured consistently; some options imply target capabilities (e.g., es/version combinations).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::compile
functions.description: Translates the input SPIR-V module to GLSL according to the current options and returns the resulting source as a string. On failure, it may throw; use get_partial_source() to retrieve partial output when exceptions occur.
requirements: CompilerGLSL must have been constructed with valid SPIR-V or IR.
Call set_common_options/add_header_line/require_extension/remap_* as needed before calling to influence output.
Caller should be prepared to handle exceptions on failure (as implied by get_partial_source() documentation).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::get_partial_source
functions.description: Returns the current contents of the internal conversion buffer. Useful for capturing partially generated GLSL when compile() throws an error.
requirements: Only meaningful after a compile() attempt that produced some output (especially on error).
No special preconditions; safe to call at any time.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::add_header_line
functions.description: Adds a line to be emitted immediately after the #version line in the GLSL output. Intended for custom directives or extensions that are outside SPIRV-Cross’ automatic handling. A newline is appended automatically.
requirements: Call before compile() to have the line included in the output.
For GLSL extensions, prefer require_extension() to avoid conflicts with compiler-managed extensions.
The string should be valid GLSL preprocessor or declaration text for the target backend.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::require_extension
functions.description: Declares that the emitted shader requires a specific GLSL extension (e.g., "GL_KHR_my_extension"). SPIRV-Cross will ensure this appears in the output and avoid collisions with internally required extensions.
requirements: Call before compile() to include the requirement in the emitted GLSL.
ext must be a valid GLSL extension name string.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::get_required_extensions
functions.description: Returns the list of required GLSL extensions. After compilation this includes both user-specified extensions and those automatically required by the compiler based on the SPIR-V.
requirements: If the caller expects auto-detected extensions to be present, call after compile().
The returned reference remains valid while the CompilerGLSL object is alive and its internal extension list is not modified.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::flatten_buffer_block
functions.description: Legacy GLSL compatibility helper that flattens a uniform or push constant block into an (i|u)vec4 array[N] declaration in the output, when applicable. The output array takes the same name as the interface block.
requirements: id must refer to a uniform or push constant variable.
All types in the block must share the same basic scalar type (e.g., mixing vec2 and vec4 is allowed; mixing int and float is not).
Call before compile() for the transformation to apply.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::variable_is_depth_or_compare
functions.description: Reports whether a given variable ID is used as a depth or comparison resource (e.g., depth images, samplers, or images used with Dref ops). Primarily meaningful for backends where descriptor types depend on this (e.g., MSL).
requirements: id must correspond to a valid variable in the IR/module.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::mask_stage_output_by_location
functions.description: Marks a shader output (by location/component) as masked when emitting stage output interfaces. Such outputs will instead be treated as private variables. Intended to resolve cross-stage matching issues in certain backends (notably MSL and HLSL).
requirements: Call before compile().
Only has effect if the corresponding output is part of the stage output interface.
location/component must match the output to be masked.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::mask_stage_output_by_builtin
functions.description: Masks a built-in output from being emitted as part of the stage output interface, treating it as a private variable instead. Used to work around specific cross-stage issues (primarily for MSL/HLSL).
requirements: Call before compile().
Only takes effect if the specified built-in is part of the stage output interface of the current shader.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::set_float_formatter
functions.description: Provides a custom float literal formatter used when emitting GLSL, or set to nullptr to use the default. The pointer is not owned by SPIRV-Cross and must remain valid until compile() completes.
requirements: formatter must remain valid (or be nullptr) until after compile() returns.
Call before compile() to affect the emitted code.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerGLSL::constant_value_macro_name
functions.description: Returns the macro name corresponding to a constant ID, enabling consistent naming of constant values in emitted code or diagnostics. Details of naming are backend-specific.
requirements: id should reference a constant in the module; otherwise the returned name may be unspecified or not correspond to any emission.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::get_hlsl_options
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the current HLSL backend Options for this CompilerHLSL instance. Use it to inspect configuration such as shader model, compatibility toggles, and type handling before or after configuration but prior to code generation impact.
requirements: The returned reference remains valid only as long as the SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL instance remains alive.
Callers must not attempt to modify the returned Options object (const reference).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::set_hlsl_options
functions.description: Sets the HLSL backend Options for this compiler instance, controlling emitted HLSL features (e.g., shader model, PointCoord/PointSize compatibility, storage buffer handling, 16-bit types, vertex input flattening, entry-point naming, and StructuredBuffer preservation). Intended to be called before compile().
requirements: Should be called before compile() to ensure options affect code generation.
If opts.enable_16bit_types is true, the target must support Shader Model 6.2 or higher (as noted in comments).

If enabling features that require auxiliary buffers (e.g., base vertex/instance support), the runtime/shader environment must provide matching resources as generated by the compiler (implied by options; exact details depend on output).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::set_root_constant_layouts
functions.description: Provides a custom layout that splits push constant ranges into explicit HLSL root constant (D3D12) or push constant (Vulkan) segments during code generation.
requirements: Each RootConstants entry’s start and end denote a byte range; both start and end must be multiples of 4 (explicitly stated).
Call before compile() so the layout is respected by generated code.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::add_vertex_attribute_remap
functions.description: Registers a remap rule for a vertex input location to a fixed HLSL semantic name. Overrides the default TEXCOORD# mapping; matrices are unrolled per row using ${SEMANTIC}_# naming.
requirements: Should be called before compile() so remaps are applied.
When flatten_matrix_vertex_input_semantics is enabled, the semantic name may be queried per active location (informational; no explicit constraints stated).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::compile
functions.description: Generates HLSL source code for the current SPIR-V module according to the configured options, remaps, bindings, and layouts. Returns the produced HLSL as a string.
requirements: Call configuration methods (e.g., set_hlsl_options, set_root_constant_layouts, add_vertex_attribute_remap, resource/binding setters) before compile() to affect output.

If remap_num_workgroups_builtin() returned a non-zero VariableID and explicit bindings are required, those must be applied to that ID before calling compile() (explicit in remap_num_workgroups_builtin docs).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::remap_num_workgroups_builtin
functions.description: Prepares a special workaround buffer for the SPIR-V NumWorkGroups builtin, which has no direct HLSL equivalent. Optionally emits a dummy cbuffer declaration hook and returns its VariableID so the application can assign explicit bindings before compilation. Returns 0 if the builtin is not statically used from the current entry point.
requirements: Must be called before compile() (explicitly stated).
If the return value is non-zero, the application should assign explicit bindings/descriptor set decorations to the returned VariableID before calling compile() (explicitly stated).
The application must provide a matching cbuffer layout at runtime: cbuffer SPIRV_Cross_NumWorkgroups : register(b#, space#) { uint3 SPIRV_Cross_NumWorkgroups_count; } (explicitly stated).
Caller must handle the case where the function returns 0 (builtin not used).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::set_resource_binding_flags
functions.description: Controls how resource bindings are emitted in HLSL (e.g., whether to omit explicit register() declarations for CBVs/SRVs/UAVs/samplers or push constants) using HLSLBindingFlagBits mask.
requirements: Pass a valid combination of HLSLBindingFlagBits in flags.
Call before compile() so flags affect emitted resource bindings.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::add_hlsl_resource_binding
functions.description: Specifies explicit HLSL register space/binding mappings (CBV/UAV/SRV/Sampler) for a SPIR-V resource identified by stage, descriptor set, and binding. Supports cases where one SPIR-V binding contains multiple HLSL resource classes.
requirements: stage/desc_set/binding in the provided resource should correspond to actual SPIR-V resources for the mapping to take effect (implied by description).
For Shader Model 5.0 and lower, the register_space field is ignored (explicitly stated in comments).
Call before compile() so mappings are applied in emitted HLSL.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::is_hlsl_resource_binding_used
functions.signature: bool SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::is_hlsl_resource_binding_used(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ExecutionModel model, uint32_t set, uint32_t binding) const
functions.description: Reports whether a previously added HLSL resource binding (by stage, set, binding) was actually referenced in the generated HLSL code for the current entry point.
requirements: Meaningful results are available after a successful call to compile() (explicitly stated: will return true after calling ::compile() if used).
model, set, and binding must match those provided via add_hlsl_resource_binding to query usage.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::set_hlsl_force_storage_buffer_as_uav
functions.description: Marks a specific storage buffer (identified by descriptor set and binding) to always be emitted as a UAV in HLSL, even if it is decorated as readonly. Overrides the default behavior where readonly storage buffers become (RW)ByteAddressBuffer SRVs.
requirements: Call before compile() for the override to affect emission.
desc_set and binding must identify an existing storage buffer resource for the override to have an effect (implied).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::set_hlsl_aux_buffer_binding
functions.signature: void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::set_hlsl_aux_buffer_binding(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::HLSLAuxBinding binding, uint32_t register_index, uint32_t register_space)
functions.description: Assigns an explicit HLSL register index and space for a special auxiliary buffer used by the backend (e.g., base vertex/instance info). By default, these magic buffers are not assigned specific bindings.
requirements: Call before compile() so explicit bindings are applied if such auxiliary buffers are needed.
register_space is only meaningful on SM 5.1+; on SM 5.0 and lower, spaces are ignored in general (consistent with earlier notes; no explicit constraint given here).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::unset_hlsl_aux_buffer_binding
functions.description: Removes any explicit register assignment previously set for an auxiliary backend buffer, reverting it to have no fixed binding.
requirements: Call before compile() to affect emitted bindings.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerHLSL::is_hlsl_aux_buffer_binding_used
functions.description: Returns whether a particular auxiliary backend buffer (identified by HLSLAuxBinding enum) was actually used by the generated HLSL code.
requirements: Best queried after compile() to reflect actual usage in the emitted shader (pattern consistent with other usage queries; explicit guarantee not stated).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::get_msl_options
functions.description: Returns the current Metal backend Options used by this compiler instance. Use to inspect configuration before or after modification.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::set_msl_options
functions.description: Sets the Metal backend Options for this compiler instance. These options control code generation (e.g., MSL version, argument buffers, workarounds).
requirements: Call before compile() to affect the generated MSL.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::get_is_rasterization_disabled
functions.description: Reports whether rasterization should be disabled for the current entry point (vertex/tessellation stages) based on analysis during compilation.
requirements: For accurate results, call after a successful compile().

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::needs_swizzle_buffer
functions.description: Indicates whether the generated shader requires an auxiliary swizzle buffer to be provided at runtime.
requirements: For accurate results, call after a successful compile().

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::needs_buffer_size_buffer
functions.description: Indicates whether a buffer containing STORAGE_BUFFER sizes (to support OpArrayLength) must be provided at runtime.
requirements: For accurate results, call after a successful compile().

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::buffer_requires_array_length
functions.description: Returns true if the specified buffer variable requires a size entry in the array-length buffer to support OpArrayLength.
requirements: Argument id must reference a buffer variable obtained through reflection for the current module.
For accurate results, call after a successful compile().

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::needs_view_mask_buffer
functions.description: Indicates whether a view-mask buffer is needed for the current configuration (multiview without view_index_from_device_index).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::needs_dispatch_base_buffer
functions.description: Indicates whether a buffer containing the dispatch base workgroup ID must be provided (when dispatch_base is enabled and MSL < 1.2).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::needs_output_buffer
functions.description: Indicates whether an output buffer must be bound (used for features like capture_output_to_buffer).
requirements: For accurate results, call after a successful compile().

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::needs_patch_output_buffer
functions.description: Indicates whether a patch output buffer must be bound (used by tessellation/capture workflows).
requirements: For accurate results, call after a successful compile().

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::needs_input_threadgroup_mem
functions.description: Indicates whether a threadgroup input buffer is needed (e.g., when capturing shader I/O to buffers).
requirements: For accurate results, call after a successful compile().

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::add_msl_shader_input
functions.description: Registers an input interface-location/builtin fix-up for MSL. Used to control formats, vecsize, rate, and explicit locations for inputs.
requirements: Call before compile().
If input.vecsize is nonzero, it must be >= the vecsize declared in the shader (else behavior is undefined).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::add_msl_shader_output
functions.description: Registers an output interface-location/builtin fix-up for MSL. Used to control formats, vecsize, rate, and explicit locations for outputs.
requirements: Call before compile().
If output.vecsize is nonzero, it must be >= the vecsize declared in the shader (else behavior is undefined).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::add_msl_resource_binding
functions.description: Provides explicit remapping of a SPIR-V (set,binding,stage) resource to specific MSL resource indices ([[buffer]], [[texture]], [[sampler]] or [[id(N)]]) and metadata (count/base type).
requirements: Call before compile().
When pad_argument_buffer_resources is enabled and the resource is not used by the shader, resource.basetype and resource.count must be correctly populated to pad the argument buffer.
For runtime-sized arrays, resource.count is used to declare a fixed array size in MSL.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::add_dynamic_buffer
functions.signature: void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::add_dynamic_buffer(uint32_t desc_set, uint32_t binding, uint32_t index)
functions.description: Marks a buffer (set,binding) as using a dynamic offset (VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_*_BUFFER_DYNAMIC). With argument buffers enabled, the shader will add the dynamic offset from a dedicated buffer at prologue.
requirements: Call before compile().
Only has effect if Options::argument_buffers is true.
index selects the position in the dynamic offset buffer for this resource and must be within the runtime-provided dynamic offset array bounds.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::add_inline_uniform_block
functions.description: Marks a (set,binding) buffer resource as an inline uniform block (VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_INLINE_UNIFORM_BLOCK_EXT). With argument buffers enabled, the block is embedded directly in the argument buffer.
requirements: Call before compile().
Only has effect if Options::argument_buffers is true.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::add_discrete_descriptor_set
functions.description: For argument-buffer mode, forces a descriptor set to use “classic” discrete MSL bindings instead of being placed in an argument buffer (similar to VK_KHR_push_descriptor behavior).
requirements: Call before compile().
Only meaningful if Options::argument_buffers is true.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::set_argument_buffer_device_address_space
functions.description: When using argument buffers, marks the storage space (constant vs device) to use for a given descriptor set argument buffer if it is large enough to require device storage.
requirements: Call before compile().
Only meaningful if Options::argument_buffers is true.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::is_msl_shader_input_used
functions.description: Queries whether an input location registered via add_msl_shader_input() was used by the generated MSL.
requirements: Must be called after a successful compile().
location must match a location passed to add_msl_shader_input().

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::is_msl_shader_output_used
functions.description: Queries whether an output location registered via add_msl_shader_output() was used by the generated MSL.
requirements: Must be called after a successful compile().
location must match a location passed to add_msl_shader_output().

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::get_automatic_builtin_input_location
functions.description: Returns the automatically assigned input attribute location for a builtin if not explicitly assigned via add_msl_shader_input(). Returns k_unknown_location if not used or explicitly assigned.
requirements: Call after compile() to query final assignments.
builtin must be a valid SPIR-V BuiltIn used as an input.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::get_automatic_builtin_output_location
functions.description: Returns the automatically assigned output attribute location for a builtin if not explicitly assigned via add_msl_shader_output(). Returns k_unknown_location if not used or explicitly assigned.
requirements: Call after compile() to query final assignments.
builtin must be a valid SPIR-V BuiltIn used as an output.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::is_msl_resource_binding_used
functions.signature: bool SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::is_msl_resource_binding_used(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ExecutionModel model, uint32_t set, uint32_t binding) const
functions.description: Returns true if a resource remapped via add_msl_resource_binding() for the specified (stage,set,binding) was referenced by the generated MSL. Constexpr samplers are treated as used implicitly.
requirements: Call after compile() to query usage.
Only remapped resources via add_msl_resource_binding() are reported here.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::get_automatic_msl_resource_binding
functions.description: Given a reflected resource variable ID, returns the auto-assigned MSL resource binding for the resource (or [[id(N)]] index for argument buffers). For combined image samplers, this returns the image half; use the *_secondary variant for the sampler half. Returns uint32_t(-1) if none.
requirements: Must be called only after a successful compile().
id must be a valid resource variable ID from reflection for this compiler instance.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::get_automatic_msl_resource_binding_secondary
functions.description: Like get_automatic_msl_resource_binding(), but for the sampler half of a combined image sampler. Returns uint32_t(-1) if not applicable.
requirements: Must be called only after a successful compile().
id must be a valid resource variable ID for a combined image sampler.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::get_automatic_msl_resource_binding_tertiary
functions.description: For combined image samplers of multiplanar images, returns the binding for the second plane. Returns uint32_t(-1) if not applicable.
requirements: Must be called only after a successful compile().
id must be a valid resource variable ID for a multiplanar combined image sampler with a second plane.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::get_automatic_msl_resource_binding_quaternary
functions.description: For combined image samplers of multiplanar images, returns the binding for the third plane. Returns uint32_t(-1) if not applicable.
requirements: Must be called only after a successful compile().
id must be a valid resource variable ID for a multiplanar combined image sampler with a third plane.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::compile
functions.description: Translates the input SPIR-V to Metal Shading Language (MSL) using the current options and remappings. Returns the generated MSL source code.
requirements: Options and remap configuration should be finalized before calling.
On success, post-compilation query APIs (is_msl_*_used, get_automatic_*_binding, etc.) become valid.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::remap_constexpr_sampler
functions.description: Remaps a sampler variable (by ID) to use a constexpr sampler in the MSL entry point. Useful for platforms that require static samplers (e.g., some iOS PCF cases). The constexpr sampler does not consume a resource binding.
requirements: Call before compile().
id must refer to a sampler or a combined image sampler variable.
The remapped sampler must not be an array of samplers.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::remap_constexpr_sampler_by_binding
functions.description: Remaps a sampler by (set,binding) to a constexpr sampler. Remaps by VariableID take priority if both are specified.
requirements: Call before compile().
Target (set,binding) must resolve to a sampler or combined image sampler.
The remapped sampler must not be an array of samplers.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::set_fragment_output_components
functions.description: Overrides the expected number of components for a specific fragment output location when Options::pad_fragment_output_components is enabled (default is 4 if not overridden).
requirements: Call before compile() for the override to take effect.
components should reflect the render target component count expected by the pipeline.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::set_combined_sampler_suffix
functions.description: Sets the suffix appended to synthesized combined sampler variable names in generated MSL.
requirements: Call before compile() to affect code generation.
suffix must be a valid null-terminated string pointer for the duration of compile().

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::get_combined_sampler_suffix
functions.description: Returns the current suffix used for synthesized combined sampler names.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::specialization_constant_is_macro
functions.description: Returns true if a specialization constant with the given ID was emitted as an MSL macro instead of a function constant.
requirements: Must be called only after a successful compile().
constant_id must correspond to a specialization constant present in the module, otherwise false is returned.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerMSL::get_fp_fast_math_flags
functions.description: Returns a mask of SPIR-V FP Fast Math Mode flags that apply across all floating-point types, optionally including operation-specific flags if incl_ops is true. Affected by SignedZeroInfNanPreserve and ContractionOff execution modes.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerCPP::CompilerCPP
functions.description: Constructs a C++ backend compiler from a SPIR-V binary provided as a vector of 32-bit words. The vector is passed by value and moved into the base compiler for ownership. Use this when you already have the SPIR-V module in a std::vector<uint32_t>. After construction, you can configure options and call compile() to generate C++ output.
requirements: spirv_ should contain a complete SPIR-V module represented as 32-bit words (in logical order).
spirv_ may be empty only if the underlying compiler accepts empty modules (unknown from this header).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerCPP::compile
functions.description: Compiles the currently loaded SPIR-V module/IR to a C++ source string that exposes the shader interface (C++-flavored backend of SPIRV-Cross). functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerReflection::compile

The exact output format and content depend on the implementation; details are not present in this header.
requirements: Must be called on an instance constructed with valid SPIR-V or ParsedIR

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::CompilerReflection::set_format

functions.name: spirv_cross_util::rename_interface_variable
functions.signature: void spirv_cross_util::rename_interface_variable(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Compiler &compiler, const SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::SmallVector<SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Resource> &resources, uint32_t location, const std::string &name)
functions.description: Renames a single interface variable (e.g., stage input/output) identified by its Location decoration within the provided resource list to the given name in the provided SPIRV-Cross compiler. Typical usage is to pass the compiler instance, the specific list of resources for a storage class (such as compiler.get_shader_resources().stage_inputs), choose the interface variable by its location, and assign a new identifier. Implementation details are not documented here; exact behavior for conflicts or missing locations is unknown.
requirements: compiler must reference a valid SPIRV-Cross Compiler that has loaded/parsed a SPIR-V module.
resources should be a resource list obtained from the same compiler instance (e.g., one of the fields returned by compiler.get_shader_resources()).
location should correspond to the Location decoration of one of the resources in the provided list; behavior is unknown if no resource matches.
name should be a valid identifier for the target backend language configured in compiler; if invalid, backend code generation may fail.
This function mutates the compiler’s internal state (names for resources); callers should ensure any subsequent name-based lookups account for the change.

functions.name: spirv_cross_util::inherit_combined_sampler_bindings
functions.description: Adjusts the compiler’s internal bindings for synthesized combined image samplers so they inherit or align with bindings derived from the original separate images/samplers. Call only after the compiler has identified/created combined image samplers (typically after invoking compiler.build_combined_image_samplers()); calling before that may have no effect.
This function mutates the compiler’s internal resource binding state; call it before final compilation/serialization of the backend source to ensure the adjusted bindings are reflected.
