functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset::set
functions.description: Sets (turns on) the specified bit index in the bitset.
requirements: bit is a zero-based bit index; any uint32_t is accepted.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset::clear
functions.description: Clears (turns off) the specified bit index in the bitset.
requirements: bit is a zero-based bit index; any uint32_t is accepted.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset::get_lower
functions.description: Returns the lower 64-bit storage mask of the bitset. Bits >= 64 are not represented in this value.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset::reset
functions.description: Clears all bits in the bitset, both the lower 64-bit mask and any higher stored bits.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset::merge_and
functions.description: Performs an in-place logical AND between this bitset and another, retaining only bits set in both.
requirements: other must be a valid Bitset reference.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset::merge_or
functions.description: Performs an in-place logical OR between this bitset and another, setting bits that are set in either.
requirements: other must be a valid Bitset reference.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset::operator==
functions.description: Compares two bitsets for equality, considering both the lower 64-bit mask and any higher bits.
requirements: other must be a valid Bitset reference.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset::operator!=
functions.description: Returns true if the bitsets are not equal. Logical negation of operator==.
requirements: other must be a valid Bitset reference.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset::for_each_bit
functions.description: Invokes the provided callable once for each set bit index in ascending order. Iteration over high bits uses a sorted temporary for deterministic order.
requirements: Op must be callable with signature like void(uint32_t) and must be valid for all set bit indices.
Callable should not assume any particular iteration complexity; higher bits are visited after sorting.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset::empty
functions.description: Returns true if no bits are set in the bitset.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::join
functions.description: Concatenates arbitrary streamable arguments into a single std::string using an internal StringStream. Avoids intermediate std::string temporaries.
requirements: Each argument must be streamable into SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::StringStream<> via operator<<.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::merge
functions.signature: inline std::string SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::merge(const SmallVector<std::string> &list, const char *between = ", ")
functions.description: Concatenates a list of strings, inserting the separator string 'between' between elements.
requirements: between must be a valid null-terminated C string if not null (default is ", ").

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::convert_to_string
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename std::enable_if<!std::is_floating_point<T>::value, int>::type = 0>
inline std::string SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::convert_to_string(const T &t)
functions.description: Generic non-floating-point overload converting a value to string via std::to_string. SFINAE excludes floating-point types; use the radix-aware overloads instead.
requirements: T must not be a floating-point type.
std::to_string(t) must be a valid expression.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::convert_to_string
functions.description: Converts a 32-bit integer to string, special-casing INT_MIN to avoid issues with unary negation on certain backends by emitting a literal-safe representation.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::convert_to_string
functions.signature: static inline std::string SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::convert_to_string(int64_t value, const std::string &int64_type, bool long_long_literal_suffix)
functions.description: Converts a 64-bit integer to string for codegen, special-casing INT64_MIN and appending a literal suffix ('l' or 'll') depending on backend requirements. For INT64_MIN, emits an explicit cast expression using int64_type.
requirements: int64_type should be a valid textual type name suitable for code generation (e.g., "int64_t" or backend-specific).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::convert_to_string
functions.description: Converts a float to a locale-stable string using a fixed printf format and normalizing the radix point to '.'. Ensures a decimal point or exponent exists and appends .0 if not present.
requirements: locale_radix_point should be the current locale's radix character for floats to enable proper normalization.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::fixup_radix_point
functions.description: In-place replaces occurrences of the given locale-specific radix_point in the C-string with '.'. Used to avoid global locale changes in multi-threaded contexts.
requirements: str must be a valid, writable, null-terminated C string.
If radix_point == '.', the function is a no-op.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::FloatFormatter::format_float
functions.description: Abstract interface: formats a float value to string. Implementations decide formatting rules (e.g., precision, suffixes).
requirements: Must be implemented by a derived class before use.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::FloatFormatter::format_double
functions.description: Abstract interface: formats a double value to string. Implementations decide formatting rules (e.g., precision, suffixes).
requirements: Must be implemented by a derived class before use.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ValueSaver::release
functions.description: Restores the referenced value to the saved snapshot captured at construction. Called automatically on destruction; can be invoked manually to restore early.
requirements: Constructed ValueSaver<T> must still be alive for release() to take effect.
T must be assignable.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Instruction::is_embedded
functions.description: Returns true if this instruction has its instruction stream embedded in the object (offset == 0), rather than referencing an external stream.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypedID::operator uint32_t
functions.description: Implicitly converts a TypedID<TypeNone> to its underlying uint32_t ID value.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypedID::operator uint32_t
functions.description: Implicitly converts a typed ID (any specialization) to its underlying uint32_t value.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypedID::operator SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypedID
functions.description: Converts a TypedID<TypeNone> to another TypedID<U> using the same underlying ID. Enables flexible passing of IDs across typed contexts.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::IVariant::clone
functions.description: Virtual constructor interface: clones the variant object into the provided object pool and returns the allocated copy.
requirements: pool must be a valid ObjectPoolBase pointer recognized by the concrete IVariant implementation.
Must be implemented by derived classes.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::operator=
functions.description: Move-assignment: releases any currently held variant, then takes ownership of other's holder and metadata, leaving other empty. Noexcept.
requirements: It is safe to move-assign a Variant onto itself is checked; no action performed.
After move, 'other' becomes empty and should not be used to access previous contents.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::operator=
functions.description: Copy-assignment: releases any currently held variant, then clones other's held object into this Variant's pool group to preserve independent ownership.
requirements: This should be used only in contexts where copying is intended; copying inside compile() may invalidate references (per comment).
Requires that this Variant has a valid pool group to allocate into.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::set
functions.description: Replaces the currently held object with 'val' of the specified type, deallocating the previous holder. If type rewrite is not allowed and types mismatch, throws.
requirements: If a holder exists, it will be deallocated using the appropriate pool.
If allow_type_rewrite is false and existing type is neither TypeNone nor new_type, the function throws and will deallocate 'val' to avoid leaks.
val must be allocated from the matching pool for new_type in this Variant's ObjectPoolGroup.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::allocate_and_set
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename... Ts>
T *SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::allocate_and_set(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Types new_type, Ts &&... ts)
functions.description: Allocates a new object of type T from the appropriate object pool, constructs it with forwarded arguments, sets it as the held object, and returns the pointer.
requirements: new_type must correspond to T::type.
Requires this Variant to have a valid ObjectPoolGroup with a pool for new_type.
Constructor of T(Ts&&...) must be well-formed.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::get
functions.description: Returns a mutable reference to the held object cast to T. Throws if no object is held or if the held type does not match T::type.
requirements: The Variant must hold a value (non-null holder).
The held type must match static_cast<Types>(T::type); otherwise the function throws via SPIRV_CROSS_THROW.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::get
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the held object cast to T. Throws if no object is held or if the held type does not match T::type.
requirements: The Variant must hold a value (non-null holder).
The held type must match static_cast<Types>(T::type); otherwise the function throws via SPIRV_CROSS_THROW.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::get_type
functions.description: Returns the runtime type tag of the currently held variant (or TypeNone if empty).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::get_id
functions.description: Returns the ID associated with the held object if any; returns 0 if empty.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::empty
functions.description: Returns true if the Variant does not currently hold an object.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::reset
functions.description: Deallocates and clears the currently held object and resets the type tag to TypeNone.
requirements: If a holder exists, it will be deallocated via its pool; after reset, the Variant is empty.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant::set_allow_type_rewrite
functions.description: Enables a one-time allowance to overwrite the current type with a different type on the next set() call.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::variant_get
functions.description: Helper that forwards to var.get<T>() to obtain a mutable reference to the held object.
requirements: var must hold an object of type T::type, otherwise SPIRV_CROSS_THROW will be triggered.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::variant_get
functions.description: Helper that forwards to var.get<T>() to obtain a const reference to the held object.
requirements: var must hold an object of type T::type, otherwise SPIRV_CROSS_THROW will be triggered.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::variant_set
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename... P>
T &SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::variant_set(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Variant &var, P &&... args)
functions.description: Allocates a new T in var's object pool using forwarded args and sets it as the held object, returning a reference to it.
requirements: T::type must correspond to the pool selected by the function.
var must have a valid ObjectPoolGroup.
Constructor T(P&&...) must be valid.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Hasher::u32
functions.description: Feeds a 32-bit value into the internal FNV-1a-like hash accumulator.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Hasher::get
functions.description: Returns the current 64-bit hash value from the accumulator.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::type_is_floating_point
functions.description: Returns true if the SPIRType is one of the floating-point base types (including Half, Float, Double, BFloat16, FloatE5M2, FloatE4M3).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::type_is_integral
functions.description: Returns true if the SPIRType is an integral scalar base type (SByte, UByte, Short, UShort, Int, UInt, Int64, UInt64).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::to_signed_basetype
functions.description: Maps an integer bit-width (8, 16, 32, 64) to the corresponding signed SPIRType::BaseType. Throws for unsupported widths.
requirements: width must be one of: 8, 16, 32, 64. Otherwise the function throws via SPIRV_CROSS_THROW.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::to_unsigned_basetype
functions.description: Maps an integer bit-width (8, 16, 32, 64) to the corresponding unsigned SPIRType::BaseType. Throws for unsupported widths.
requirements: width must be one of: 8, 16, 32, 64. Otherwise the function throws via SPIRV_CROSS_THROW.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::opcode_is_sign_invariant
functions.description: Returns true if the integer arithmetic/logical opcode behaves the same for signed and unsigned operands (e.g., equality, add, mul, bitwise ops, shifts).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::opcode_can_promote_integer_implicitly
functions.description: Returns true if the opcode can implicitly operate on promoted integer types without changing semantics (e.g., unary/binary bitwise ops, shifts, add/sub/mul/div/mod variants).

functions.name: std::hash::operator()
functions.description: Hash functor specialization for SPIRV-Cross TypedID<T>. Computes a size_t hash from the underlying uint32_t ID using std::hash<uint32_t>. Enables use in unordered containers.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::ParsedIR
functions.description: Default constructor. Initializes an empty ParsedIR container and associated object pools for SPIR-V cross-compilation and reflection.
requirements: No arguments required.
Constructed object is empty until IDs, types, and SPIR-V words are populated.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::operator=
functions.description: Copy assignment operator. Replaces this ParsedIR's contents with a deep copy of other, handling custom pool-allocated resources.
requirements: This and other may be the same object (self-assignment should be safe).
Existing resources in this are released/replaced as needed.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_id_bounds
functions.description: Resizes internal ID-related containers (ids, meta, block_meta) to accommodate IDs in [0, bounds).
requirements: bounds specifies the SPIR-V module's ID bound (typically from the SPIR-V header).
Must be called before inserting or accessing IDs beyond current bounds to avoid out-of-range access.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_name
functions.description: Associates a friendly name with a given SPIR-V ID for reflection and code generation.
requirements: id must be within current ID bounds and correspond to an existing entity.
name may be sanitized later to avoid reserved identifiers.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_name
functions.description: Returns the friendly name previously assigned to id, or an empty string if none is set.
requirements: id must be within current ID bounds.
Returned reference remains valid as long as the ParsedIR is alive and the name is not modified.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_decoration
functions.signature: void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_decoration(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ID id, SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Decoration decoration, uint32_t argument = 0)
functions.description: Sets a numeric decoration on an ID, optionally with an argument (e.g., DescriptorSet, Binding, Location).
requirements: id must be valid and within bounds.
Decoration must be appropriate for the ID kind (not enforced here, but required by SPIR-V semantics).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_decoration_string
functions.signature: void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_decoration_string(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ID id, SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Decoration decoration, const std::string &argument)
functions.description: Sets a string decoration on an ID (e.g., HLSL semantic or user-defined labels).
requirements: id must be valid and within bounds.
decoration must be one that accepts a string operand (library-specific).

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::has_decoration
functions.description: Checks whether a given decoration is set on an ID.
requirements: id must be within bounds.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_decoration
functions.description: Retrieves the numeric argument for a decoration on an ID. If unset, behavior depends on internal defaults (unknown from header).
requirements: id must be within bounds.
Decoration must have been set with a numeric argument to obtain a meaningful value.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_decoration_string
functions.signature: const std::string & SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_decoration_string(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ID id, SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Decoration decoration) const
functions.description: Retrieves the string argument for a decoration on an ID, or an empty string if unset.
requirements: id must be within bounds.
Decoration must have been set with a string argument to obtain a meaningful value.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_decoration_bitset
functions.description: Returns the bitset of all decorations applied to id.
requirements: id must be within bounds.
Returned reference is valid while ParsedIR and its meta data remain unchanged.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::unset_decoration
functions.description: Clears a specific decoration on id.
requirements: id must be within bounds.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_member_name
functions.signature: void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_member_name(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypeID id, uint32_t index, const std::string &name)
functions.description: Sets a friendly name for a member of a struct type.
requirements: id must refer to a struct type.
index must be a valid member index for the given struct type.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_member_name
functions.signature: const std::string & SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_member_name(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypeID id, uint32_t index) const
functions.description: Gets the name of a struct type member, or an empty string if none is set.
requirements: id must refer to a struct type within bounds.
index must be a valid member index.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_member_decoration
functions.signature: void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_member_decoration(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypeID id, uint32_t index, SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Decoration decoration, uint32_t argument = 0)
functions.description: Sets a numeric decoration on a struct type member.
requirements: id must refer to a struct type.
index must be a valid member index.
Decoration must be appropriate for member decorations.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_member_decoration_string
functions.signature: void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::set_member_decoration_string(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypeID id, uint32_t index, SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Decoration decoration, const std::string &argument)
functions.description: Sets a string decoration on a struct type member.
requirements: id must refer to a struct type.
index must be a valid member index.
Decoration must accept string operands for members.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_member_decoration
functions.signature: uint32_t SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_member_decoration(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypeID id, uint32_t index, SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Decoration decoration) const
functions.description: Retrieves the numeric argument for a decoration on a struct type member.
requirements: id must refer to a struct type and be within bounds.
index must be a valid member index.
Decoration must have been set with a numeric argument.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_member_decoration_string
functions.signature: const std::string & SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_member_decoration_string(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypeID id, uint32_t index, SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Decoration decoration) const
functions.description: Retrieves the string argument for a decoration on a struct type member, or an empty string if unset.
requirements: id must refer to a struct type.
index must be a valid member index.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::has_member_decoration
functions.signature: bool SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::has_member_decoration(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypeID id, uint32_t index, SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Decoration decoration) const
functions.description: Checks if a struct type member has a given decoration.
requirements: id must refer to a struct type within bounds.
index must be a valid member index.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_member_decoration_bitset
functions.signature: const SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Bitset & SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_member_decoration_bitset(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypeID id, uint32_t index) const
functions.description: Returns the bitset of decorations applied to a struct type member.
requirements: id must refer to a struct type within bounds.
index must be a valid member index.
Returned reference remains valid as long as the underlying meta is not modified.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::unset_member_decoration
functions.signature: void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::unset_member_decoration(SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::TypeID id, uint32_t index, SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::Decoration decoration)
functions.description: Clears a decoration on a struct type member.
requirements: id must refer to a struct type within bounds.
index must be a valid member index.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::mark_used_as_array_length
functions.description: Marks an ID as being used as an array length expression (for later fixups or reflection).
requirements: id must be within bounds and typically refer to a constant or specialization constant.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::increase_bound_by
functions.description: Increases the current ID bound by count and resizes internal structures accordingly. Returns the previous bound (or the first new ID index).
requirements: count may be zero or positive. Negative values are not allowed (unsigned).
Must be called before using newly allocated IDs.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_buffer_block_flags
functions.description: Computes and returns the set of effective buffer block decorations/flags for the given variable.
requirements: var must refer to a valid buffer/interface variable present in this ParsedIR.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_buffer_block_type_flags
functions.description: Computes and returns the set of effective buffer block flags based on a SPIR-V type (e.g., layout-related decorations).
requirements: type must be a valid SPIRType owned by this ParsedIR.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::add_typed_id
functions.description: Registers id in the internal per-type index (ids_for_type) for quick iteration over resources of the given kind.
requirements: type must be a valid Types enum value.
id must be within bounds and refer to an object of the matching type.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::remove_typed_id
functions.description: Unregisters id from the per-type index (ids_for_type).
requirements: type must be a valid Types enum value.
id must be within bounds and currently registered for that type.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::create_loop_hard_lock
functions.description: Creates a hard loop lock guard object. While held, calling set<> or mutating typed arrays during iteration is an error (likely triggers exception).
requirements: Caller must keep the returned LoopLock alive for the entire iteration scope.
Do not call functions that mutate typed ID arrays while a hard lock is held.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::create_loop_soft_lock
functions.description: Creates a soft loop lock guard. While held, additions to typed arrays are silently ignored (used for physical ID remapping).
requirements: Caller must keep the returned LoopLock alive for the scope where mutations may happen.
Soft lock should only be used when additions can be ignored safely.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::reset_all_of_type
functions.description: Template helper that resets all IDs of the given compile-time type T (maps to a Types enum via T::type).
requirements: T must expose a static constexpr or enum value 'type' convertible to Types.
May not be called while a hard loop lock is held for the same arrays.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::reset_all_of_type
functions.description: Resets internal state for all IDs of the given runtime-specified type.
requirements: type must be a valid Types enum.
May not be called while a hard loop lock is held for the same arrays.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::find_meta
functions.description: Finds and returns a pointer to mutable Meta for the given ID, or nullptr if none exists.
requirements: id must be within bounds.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::find_meta
functions.description: Finds and returns a pointer to const Meta for the given ID, or nullptr if none exists.
requirements: id must be within bounds.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_empty_string
functions.description: Returns a reference to an internal empty string singleton to avoid creating temporaries.
requirements: Reference remains valid for the lifetime of the ParsedIR instance.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::make_constant_null
functions.signature: void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::make_constant_null(uint32_t id, uint32_t type, bool add_to_typed_id_set)
functions.description: Creates or converts the given id into a constant null of the specified type. Optionally registers it in the typed ID set.
requirements: id must be within bounds and available to represent a constant.
type must be a valid TypeID (uint32_t) referring to an existing SPIRType.
If add_to_typed_id_set is true, the ID will be added to the appropriate typed list.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::fixup_reserved_names
functions.description: Sanitizes and fixes up any names that would conflict with reserved identifiers in target languages.
requirements: Should be called after names are assigned but before code generation.
May modify previously set names to ensure validity.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::sanitize_underscores
functions.description: Utility to normalize/sanitize leading/trailing or repeated underscores in an identifier string.
requirements: str is modified in-place.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::sanitize_identifier
functions.signature: static void SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::sanitize_identifier(std::string &str, bool member, bool allow_reserved_prefixes)
functions.description: Sanitizes an identifier for use in generated code, considering member context and whether reserved prefixes are allowed.
requirements: str is modified in-place.
member indicates member vs global identifier context.
allow_reserved_prefixes controls whether reserved prefixes are permitted.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::is_globally_reserved_identifier
functions.description: Returns true if the identifier is globally reserved and should be altered for code generation.
requirements: str is examined; may or may not be modified (unknown from header).
Behavior depends on allow_reserved_prefixes.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::get_spirv_version
functions.description: Returns the SPIR-V version number encoded for this module (major/minor packed, exact encoding per library).
requirements: ParsedIR must have source/version info populated to return a meaningful value.

functions.name: SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE::ParsedIR::LoopLock::LoopLock
functions.description: Constructs a loop lock guard bound to an iteration depth counter. Increments the counter on construction.
requirements: counter must be a valid, non-null pointer to a counter owned by a ParsedIR instance.

functions.name: SpvHasResultAndType
functions.signature: inline void SpvHasResultAndType(SpvOp opcode, bool *hasResult, bool *hasResultType)
functions.description: Determines, for a given SPIR-V opcode, whether the instruction produces a result id and whether a result type id is required. Writes the answers to the two out-parameters. Intended for utility/introspection of SPIR-V instruction metadata; returns info for known opcodes and leaves both flags false for unknown opcodes.
requirements: SPV_ENABLE_UTILITY_CODE must be defined for this function to be available from this header.
hasResult must be a valid, non-null pointer writable by the caller.
hasResultType must be a valid, non-null pointer writable by the caller.
opcode should be a valid SpvOp enumerant; unknown values cause both outputs to remain as initialized false for the default path.
Thread-safe and reentrant; no global state is modified.

import random
import string
from typing import List

# We generate arbitrary strings that are useful for SPIRV-Cross name/extension/header/semanitc inputs.
# Goals:
# - Non-empty by default.
# - Include variants: valid identifier, HLSL/GLSL semantics, extension-like tokens, entry point names,
#   strings with spaces/newlines (to exercise sanitizers), unusual unicode bytes, and comma radix cases.
# - Keep size <= 4096 bytes.

IDENT_START = string.ascii_letters + "_"
IDENT_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_"

HLSL_SEMANTICS = [
    "POSITION", "NORMAL", "TANGENT", "BINORMAL", "COLOR", "TEXCOORD", "SV_Position",
    "SV_Target", "SV_VertexID", "SV_InstanceID", "SV_IsFrontFace", "SV_PrimitiveID",
]

GL_EXT_BASE = [
    "GL_EXT_shader_framebuffer_fetch",
    "GL_EXT_nonuniform_qualifier",
    "GL_ARB_separate_shader_objects",
    "GL_KHR_vulkan_glsl",
]

MSL_SUFFIXES = ["_CS", "_SMP", "Sampler", "Tex", "_Combined"]

ENTRY_NAMES = ["main", "_bad name!", "MainEntry", "Compute_Main", "vertex_main", "psMain"]

# Some unicode-like bytes and punctuation to exercise sanitization paths.
WEIRD_BYTES = [
    b"name-with-dash", b"name with space", b"name,with,comma", b"__double__underscore__",
    "ümlaut".encode("utf-8", errors="ignore"), b"newline\ninside", b"carriage\rreturn",
]


def rand_identifier(rng: random.Random, min_len=1, max_len=32) -> str:
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    start = rng.choice(IDENT_START)
    body = ''.join(rng.choice(IDENT_CHARS) for _ in range(max(0, n - 1)))
    return start + body


def rand_ext(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    base = rng.choice(GL_EXT_BASE)
    # optional fuzz suffix
    suf_len = rng.randint(0, 12)
    suf = ''.join(ch if ch.isalnum() else '_' for ch in ''.join(rng.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_") for _ in range(suf_len)))
    return base if not suf else base + "_" + suf


def rand_semantic(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    base = rng.choice(HLSL_SEMANTICS)
    # Often TEXCOORDn, COLORn forms
    if base in ("TEXCOORD", "COLOR"):
        return f"{base}{rng.randint(0,15)}"
    return base


def rand_msl_suffix(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    suf = rng.choice(MSL_SUFFIXES)
    # sometimes append an index
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        suf += str(rng.randint(0, 9))
    return suf


def rand_header_line(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Avoid newlines to respect single-line expectations; inject commas/equals etc.
    parts = ["#define", rand_identifier(rng), str(rng.randint(0, 1024))]
    return ' '.join(parts)


def rand_with_radix(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # A number string with either '.' or ',' as radix
    whole = str(rng.randint(0, 9999))
    frac = str(rng.randint(0, 9999)).rjust(2, '0')
    radix = ',' if rng.random() < 0.5 else '.'
    return whole + radix + frac


def assemble_pool(rng: random.Random) -> List[bytes]:
    pool: List[bytes] = []
    # Valid identifiers
    for _ in range(4):
        pool.append(rand_identifier(rng).encode('utf-8'))
    # HLSL semantics
    for _ in range(4):
        pool.append(rand_semantic(rng).encode('utf-8'))
    # GLSL extension-like
    for _ in range(3):
        pool.append(rand_ext(rng).encode('utf-8'))
    # MSL combined sampler suffixes
    for _ in range(3):
        pool.append(rand_msl_suffix(rng).encode('utf-8'))
    # Entry point names (some intentionally odd)
    for nm in ENTRY_NAMES:
        pool.append(nm.encode('utf-8'))
    # Header lines
    for _ in range(3):
        pool.append(rand_header_line(rng).encode('utf-8'))
    # Strings with commas/newlines/etc.
    for wb in WEIRD_BYTES:
        pool.append(wb)
    # Radix cases
    for _ in range(3):
        pool.append(rand_with_radix(rng).encode('utf-8'))
    # Random short free-form strings (sanitized later by APIs if needed)
    alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + " _-,:;[](){}<>/.\n\r"
    for _ in range(6):
        ln = rng.randint(1, 64)
        s = ''.join(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(ln))
        pool.append(s.encode('utf-8', errors='ignore'))
    return pool


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    pool = assemble_pool(rng)
    # Choose 1..5 segments and join with a small separator to create variety but keep under 4KB
    count = rng.randint(1, 5)
    segs = [rng.choice(pool) for _ in range(count)]
    sep_options = [b"", b" ", b"_", b"-", b",", b"/", b"::"]
    sep = rng.choice(sep_options)
    out = sep.join(segs)
    # Ensure non-empty and size bound
    if not out:
        out = b"x"
    if len(out) > 4096:
        out = out[:4096]
    return out

import random
import struct
from typing import List

# Generates small, valid SPIR-V binaries (as bytes) suitable for feeding into
# spvc_context_parse_spirv and SPIRV-Cross Parser constructors.
# We construct minimal modules for various execution models with a trivial entry point.
# The buffer is a sequence of 32-bit words; we return it as bytes.

SPIRV_MAGIC = 0x07230203
SPIRV_VERSION_1_3 = 0x00010300  # SPIR-V 1.3

# Opcodes
OP_CAPABILITY = 17
OP_MEMORY_MODEL = 14
OP_ENTRY_POINT = 15
OP_EXECUTION_MODE = 16
OP_NAME = 5
OP_TYPE_VOID = 19
OP_TYPE_FUNCTION = 33
OP_FUNCTION = 54
OP_FUNCTION_END = 56
OP_FUNCTION_PARAMETER = 55
OP_FUNCTION_CALL = 57
OP_LABEL = 248
OP_RETURN = 253

# Execution models
EXEC_MODEL_VERTEX = 0
EXEC_MODEL_FRAGMENT = 4
EXEC_MODEL_GL_COMPUTE = 5

# Memory model enums
ADDR_LOGICAL = 0
MEM_MODEL_GLSL450 = 1

# Capability enums
CAP_SHADER = 1

# ExecutionMode enums (optional small variety)
EXEC_MODE_ORIGIN_UPPER_LEFT = 7   # Fragment
EXEC_MODE_LOCAL_SIZE = 17         # Compute


def _word(opcode: int, word_count: int) -> int:
    return ((word_count & 0xFFFF) << 16) | (opcode & 0xFFFF)


def _pack_words(words: List[int]) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack("<%dI" % len(words), *words)


def _minimal_shader_module(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Build a very small module with a single void() function as entry point.
    # Id allocation
    # 1: void type
    # 2: function type void()
    # 3: function id (entry)
    # 4: label id
    # 5: (optionally used by variants)
    id_bound = 6

    words: List[int] = []

    # Header: magic, version, generator, bound, reserved
    words += [
        SPIRV_MAGIC,
        SPIRV_VERSION_1_3,
        0,            # generator
        id_bound,     # bound
        0             # reserved
    ]

    # Capability Shader
    words += [
        _word(OP_CAPABILITY, 2),
        CAP_SHADER
    ]

    # MemoryModel Logical, GLSL450
    words += [
        _word(OP_MEMORY_MODEL, 3),
        ADDR_LOGICAL,
        MEM_MODEL_GLSL450
    ]

    # Select a stage and entry point name
    stage = rng.choice([EXEC_MODEL_VERTEX, EXEC_MODEL_FRAGMENT, EXEC_MODEL_GL_COMPUTE])
    entry_name = rng.choice([b"main", b"_entry", b"e0"])  # ASCII
    name_bytes = entry_name + b"\x00"
    name_words = list(struct.unpack("<%dI" % ((len(name_bytes)+3)//4), name_bytes.ljust(((len(name_bytes)+3)//4)*4, b"\x00")))

    # OpEntryPoint <stage> %3 "name"
    words += [
        _word(OP_ENTRY_POINT, 3 + len(name_words)),
        stage,
        3
    ] + name_words

    # For some stages, add a sensible execution mode to further increase validity.
    if stage == EXEC_MODEL_FRAGMENT:
        # OriginUpperLeft
        words += [
            _word(OP_EXECUTION_MODE, 3),
            3,  # function id
            EXEC_MODE_ORIGIN_UPPER_LEFT
        ]
    elif stage == EXEC_MODEL_GL_COMPUTE:
        # LocalSize x,y,z
        lx, ly, lz = (rng.choice([1, 2, 4, 8]), rng.choice([1, 2, 4, 8]), rng.choice([1, 2, 4]))
        words += [
            _word(OP_EXECUTION_MODE, 6),
            3,
            EXEC_MODE_LOCAL_SIZE,
            lx, ly, lz
        ]

    # Name the function (optional but harmless)
    words += [
        _word(OP_NAME, 3 + len(name_words)),
        3
    ] + name_words

    # Types: OpTypeVoid %1
    words += [
        _word(OP_TYPE_VOID, 2),
        1
    ]

    # OpTypeFunction %2 %1
    words += [
        _word(OP_TYPE_FUNCTION, 3),
        2,
        1
    ]

    # Function definition: %3 = OpFunction %1 None %2
    words += [
        _word(OP_FUNCTION, 5),
        1,   # return type = void
        3,   # result id
        0,   # function control mask
        2    # function type
    ]

    # Label
    words += [
        _word(OP_LABEL, 2),
        4
    ]

    # Return
    words += [
        _word(OP_RETURN, 1)
    ]

    # FunctionEnd
    words += [
        _word(OP_FUNCTION_END, 1)
    ]

    return _pack_words(words)


def _variant_module(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Occasionally generate multiple entry points or different names to diversify behavior,
    # while keeping validity. Keep very small to stay under fuzz limits.
    multi = rng.random() < 0.25
    if not multi:
        return _minimal_shader_module(rng)

    # Two-entry-point module sharing the same trivial function body (distinct ids).
    id_bound = 10
    words: List[int] = []
    words += [SPIRV_MAGIC, SPIRV_VERSION_1_3, 0, id_bound, 0]
    words += [_word(OP_CAPABILITY, 2), CAP_SHADER]
    words += [_word(OP_MEMORY_MODEL, 3), ADDR_LOGICAL, MEM_MODEL_GLSL450]

    # Entry 1 (vertex, %3)
    name1 = b"vmain\x00"
    n1w = list(struct.unpack("<%dI" % ((len(name1)+3)//4), name1.ljust(((len(name1)+3)//4)*4, b"\x00")))
    words += [_word(OP_ENTRY_POINT, 3 + len(n1w)), EXEC_MODEL_VERTEX, 3] + n1w

    # Entry 2 (fragment, %6)
    name2 = b"fmain\x00"
    n2w = list(struct.unpack("<%dI" % ((len(name2)+3)//4), name2.ljust(((len(name2)+3)//4)*4, b"\x00")))
    words += [_word(OP_ENTRY_POINT, 3 + len(n2w)), EXEC_MODEL_FRAGMENT, 6] + n2w
    words += [_word(OP_EXECUTION_MODE, 3), 6, EXEC_MODE_ORIGIN_UPPER_LEFT]

    # Names
    words += [_word(OP_NAME, 3 + len(n1w)), 3] + n1w
    words += [_word(OP_NAME, 3 + len(n2w)), 6] + n2w

    # Types
    words += [_word(OP_TYPE_VOID, 2), 1]
    words += [_word(OP_TYPE_FUNCTION, 3), 2, 1]

    # Function %3
    words += [_word(OP_FUNCTION, 5), 1, 3, 0, 2]
    words += [_word(OP_LABEL, 2), 4]
    words += [_word(OP_RETURN, 1)]
    words += [_word(OP_FUNCTION_END, 1)]

    # Function %6
    words += [_word(OP_FUNCTION, 5), 1, 6, 0, 2]
    words += [_word(OP_LABEL, 2), 7]
    words += [_word(OP_RETURN, 1)]
    words += [_word(OP_FUNCTION_END, 1)]

    return _pack_words(words)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Randomly choose a small valid module variant.
    blob = _variant_module(rng)
    # Enforce size cap required by stubs (< 2048 bytes and <= 512 words for the other stub).
    if len(blob) > 2048:
        blob = blob[:2048]
    # Ensure at least one word (guaranteed by construction), and alignment is already 4 bytes.
    return blob
